cands.bio: Etowah County business owner who runs Butler Electrical Contractors and Butler Properties with his wife. Republican state representative, first for District 30 (elected 2012) and then for District 28 (since 2022). Former Etowah County Board of Education president and Etowah County Republican Party chairman.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Butler was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. His Ballotpedia page lists no bills he sponsored. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, land ownership by out-of-state or foreign buyers, immigration or H-1B, policing, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site says only that he will oppose higher taxes and cut taxes and wasteful spending, without naming property taxes. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no endorsements, controversies or foreign ties in the pages reviewed.

cands.bio: Robert Hunter was the 2026 Democratic nominee for Alabama House District 28. He advanced without a primary and lost the general election to incumbent Mack Butler (R). Ballotpedia lists no prior offices or occupation.

endorsements.text: North Alabama Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), listed on Ballotpedia and named by Hunter in his survey.
For the Future Victory Fund, named by Hunter in his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.
Ballotpedia also lists several Sway voter-guide recommendations, including Tabitha's List and 'Reject AIPAC from City Council to Congress'.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Robert Hunter was born or raised, when he came to Alabama, or his occupation and work history. We found no record of earlier elected office. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign themes were a 10% annual rent increase cap for owners of more than two houses, Medicaid expansion, and a $10 minimum wage tied to rent costs. We did not find any other reporting or a personal biography.
